articles.summary: SBA Communications Corporation (Nasdaq: SBAC) ("SBA" or the "Company") today reported results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. Highlights of the first quarter include: Net income attributable to SBA of $184.8 million or $1.74 per share Industry-leading AFFO per share of $3.03 Increased full year 2026 outlook across all key metrics Company-wide Tower Cash Flow margin of approximately 80% In addition, the Company announced today that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash divide
articles.title: SBA Communications Corporation Reports First Quarter 2026 Results; Updates Full Year 2026 Outlook; and Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend
